---
title: "R Primers for ISEM"
toc: false
---

A version of the old RStudio/Posit Primers, ported to Quarto and webR by [Andrew Heiss](https://www.andrewheiss.com/)
and adjusted to suit the needs of [*Introduction to Structural Equation Modeling*](https://kylemlang.com/isem) by [Kyle
M. Lang](https://kylemlang.com).

## License {.appendix}
